markdown: **Activate—Invisible Pounce** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You are in bright light; **Effect** You become [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83), [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) up to your speed, and then make a melee [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) at the end of that movement. After making the Strike, you are no longer invisible. If at any point during your Stride, you pass out of [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2402), you are no longer invisible and must stop moving. You may make a melee Strike if you have a target within reach.

text: Activate—Invisible Pounce Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Requirements You are in bright light; Effect You become invisible, Stride up to your speed, and then make a melee Strike at the end of that movement. After making the Strike, you are no longer invisible. If at any point during your Stride, you pass out of bright light, you are no longer invisible and must stop moving. You may make a melee Strike if you have a target within reach.
